programme.title: True or False
programme.desc: It is the most serious scandal ever hitting the modern art market An affair that has made experts and auction houses tremble and has re-proposed the ghost of forgery The facts date back to 2017 in Genoa, where an exhibition dedicated to the painter Amedeo Modigliani from Livorno was closed by the Public Prosecutor’s Office, which put 21 paintings out of the 60 on display under seizure

programme.title: A Russian Fairytale
programme.desc: Following the break up of the Soviet union, a gang of children from broken homes made a new life together inside the derelict buildings of a once secret weapons manufacturing city In their childhood innocence, they thought they were living a fairytale dream of freedom, but with starvation and sub zero temperatures crippling their health, reality soon hit home Despite their efforts to care for one another, three members of their group died For the survivors: they must try against hopeless odds to turn their lives around

programme.title: Black and Blue
programme.desc: In 2011, six police officers in Fullerton, California, beat Kelly Thomas, a homeless schizophrenic man, so badly that he died of his injuries Three years later, protests in Hollywood sparked after the officers were acquitted or had their charges dropped Renowned filmmaker Dylan Avery attended the protest and, before he knew it, he was swept up into a world of grieving family members, retired police officers that now criticize the very system they used to serve, and civilians who have suffered brutality at the hands of those sworn to protect Over the next two years, Avery followed multiple cases and developments that coincided with historic protests on the streets of Ferguson and Baltimore against institutionalized police racism and brutality

programme.title: The Rapture Of Free Soloing On Acid
programme.desc: This film follows the legendary climbing photographer and Stone Master, Dean Fidelman Fidelman was at the forefront of the free climbing revolution in Yosemite Valley and Joshua Tree during the 1970s, making photographs with John Bachar, Lynn Hill, Ron Kauk, John Long, and many other talented climbers Over the past four decades, Fidelman has continued to document the evolution of rock climbing as a sport and culture This documentary takes a look at his impact and influence as a photographer and climber

programme.desc: A reflection on war, on what the human being is capable of doing and on the job of reporter at the front Fourteen years after recounting the conflict that shook Lebanon in 2006, Gianluca Grossi returns to the Land of the Cedars to confront a question that, over time,has become increasingly cumbersome: «What have I been used for? What is my job for? »

programme.title: Milan, Everyone At Home
programme.desc: It’s a hot Sunday in March in Milan, when Claudio Rizzotti, freelance filmmaker, decides to take his camera to document what is beginning to happen around him It is the beginning of the Italian lockdown for the Covid 19 pandemic and so his city, his friends and his family sink into a long lethargy

programme.title: Cries from Syria
programme.desc: Covering five years of conflict, Cries from Syria serves as a record of Syria's brutal disintegration and the dangers faced by its many refugees Incorporating gripping first-hand accounts from activists, child protesters, and a former army general who joined the uprising, this compelling documentary bears witness to the resilience of the people in the wake of their exposure to unthinkable crimes against humanity

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 世界生命之道:鄺保亮牧師
programme.desc: 鄺保亮牧師,與父親鄺健雄牧師一同於新加坡帶領9千多人的教會,承傳父親熱心佈道的精神,繼續以激勵人心的資訊,挑戰我們成為為主擺上的門徒!

programme.title: 一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會
programme.desc: 由「愛基金」主辦、「創世電視」協辦的「一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會」,聯合不同教會的力量,加上演藝人的見證,將福音帶給香港市民。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 啟示錄研讀-張永信牧師
programme.desc: 聖經最後的一卷啟示錄,常被信徒,甚至普世人類所注重。可惜的是,被誤解和誤用的情況卻很普遍。解釋啟示錄最大的問題,便是讀者們對於此書卷的體裁所知甚少,以致不明白詮釋啟示錄的方法。本節目傾重於對啟示錄體裁的闡釋,讓觀眾明白如何將方法論,應用在各有關的經文上。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 創世記 -呂沛淵牧師
programme.desc: 呂沛淵牧師是美國西敏神學院神學博士。曾任洛杉磯台福神學院系統神學及教會歷史專任教授。現任美國加州矽穀一華人教會牧師與神學院教授。邁向新一年, 呂牧師以《創世記》, 探討上帝創造世界與你今天的關係, 為一年之始作好準備。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 你是主角

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 鋼琴大師的生命樂章

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 啟示錄研讀-張永信牧師
programme.desc: 聖經最後的一卷啟示錄,常被信徒,甚至普世人類所注重。可惜的是,被誤解和誤用的情況卻很普遍。解釋啟示錄最大的問題,便是讀者們對於此書卷的體裁所知甚少,以致不明白詮釋啟示錄的方法。本節目傾重於對啟示錄體裁的闡釋,讓觀眾明白如何將方法論,應用在各有關的經文上。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 創世記 -呂沛淵牧師
programme.desc: 呂沛淵牧師是美國西敏神學院神學博士。曾任洛杉磯台福神學院系統神學及教會歷史專任教授。現任美國加州矽穀一華人教會牧師與神學院教授。邁向新一年, 呂牧師以《創世記》, 探討上帝創造世界與你今天的關係, 為一年之始作好準備。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-不由你不信之從萬物創造到深邃的愛
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」。梁明彪博士分享上帝如何從人類各器官的精密構造,看到上帝創造是多麼奇妙偉大,每個人的出生就是一場最嚴謹的監製,原來正常的生命就是一場神蹟。在領受上帝創造恩典之時,明白祂在創造過程對人的慈愛和關懷。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 啟示錄研讀-張永信牧師
programme.desc: 聖經最後的一卷啟示錄,常被信徒,甚至普世人類所注重。可惜的是,被誤解和誤用的情況卻很普遍。解釋啟示錄最大的問題,便是讀者們對於此書卷的體裁所知甚少,以致不明白詮釋啟示錄的方法。本節目傾重於對啟示錄體裁的闡釋,讓觀眾明白如何將方法論,應用在各有關的經文上。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 創世記 -呂沛淵牧師
programme.desc: 呂沛淵牧師是美國西敏神學院神學博士。曾任洛杉磯台福神學院系統神學及教會歷史專任教授。現任美國加州矽穀一華人教會牧師與神學院教授。邁向新一年, 呂牧師以《創世記》, 探討上帝創造世界與你今天的關係, 為一年之始作好準備。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室

香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 航向未來粵
高朋滿座#232粵
programme.desc: 喜清早決戰四方城，原來是喜聽到慶參加義診團所進行的報復。朋對慶游說失敗，續約慶行山，欲以用行動來證明慶根本無力應付雲南的惡劣環境。縱使朋有充分的行山裝備，仍敵不過精力充沛的慶，朋更不支暈倒被送入院。

programme.title: 說英雄誰是英雄#3粵普PG
programme.desc: 出發前，蘇夢枕將紅袖刀交給要假扮成他的小石，並教他一個招式，說江湖中人看到就會相信；蘇遮幕將扳指交給蘇夢枕，叮囑他要守好這個江湖，並要他去問花無錯是否知錯，父子倆一起喝下最後一杯酒，夢枕登上樓主之位。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作粵
阿媽教落食平D粵
programme.desc: 六號向肥媽請教潮爆食譜，肥媽先要他以「廚房神器」做出「早餐6食」，「啡菇伴蛋」、「咖喱飯冬甩」、「迷你pizza」輕易完成！肥媽用元貝、椰菜做出特色大阪燒餅，六號用小聰明設計穩妥方法，再也不怕翻動美食！「羊肉黃薑飯」、「香烤羊架伴鮮羊肚菌」，做法簡單得令六號嚷着要與肥媽鬥煮。「吸」出心形酥皮、倒入蛋漿，數分鐘後，愛心滿載的「一口酥皮蛋撻」新鮮出爐。六號餵食時慘「食檸檬」，說了甚麼令肥媽笑到肚痛？

programme.title: 航向未來粵
programme.desc: 運輸及物流局積極推動本港的海空聯運，節目《航向未來》由星級藝員吳偉豪、郭柏妍擔綱演出，並飾演初到海運前線的實習生，透過實況情節，介紹當局如何精準高效地協調貨船泊進港口後，把船上貨物經香港轉運出海，繼而運往世界各地，同時為國際航運業綠色減碳出力。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 「口乾燥症」患者因口水分泌不足，可能會影響進食、吞嚥、說話，甚或引致口臭、味覺改變等狀況，曾接受電療、常用口呼吸人士都是高危一族。牙醫建議針對源頭做舒緩及保護，還要關注口腔衛生。高膽固醇是「三高」之一，中醫學把它歸類為「脂濁」、「痰濕」，並與腎臟及脾胃有關。治療方面，主要根據病因而用藥及針灸，中醫師也會介紹相關穴位按壓方法，並提醒飲食上的注意事項。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓炮製「青口汁粟米燜雞」。

programme.title: 拍檔廚房粵
programme.desc: 《拍檔廚房》每次請來兩對由藝員與廚師組成的搭檔，參加四個回合的比賽。首集先是「拍檔聯乘」，評判顧紀筠、黃永幟、方曉嵐、顏志恆從味道等三準則，品嚐評分。龔嘉欣不乏餐飲業經驗，與酒店餐廳大廚李家鋌做拍檔，獻上別開生面的「寶石紫薑皮蛋」。對家「疫境廚神」黎諾懿夥拍擅長非一般法國菜的沈依紅，以「蔥油蟶子天使麵」打頭陣。不過，兩道頭盤均被評略嫌不足！兩隊分別用馬友魚、馬頭魚製作的主菜，又能否協助搶分響頭炮？

programme.title: 大帥哥#8粵PG
programme.desc: 落蘆早料到狄奇去分地盤會失敗收場，只想讓他認清自己的兵力多麼不濟，建議用計挑起細龜、佘南互相殘殺。落蘆終答應加入狄奇的陣營，首要任務是開軍校及招兵，羅義、馬炭爭做實戰總教官，密密苦練槍法。馬炭慨嘆斷指影響表現，沅婉內疚地為他倒模做假手指及指套，馬炭憶起兒時片段，不自覺握住沅婉的手，剛好被狄奇看見，懷疑二人有染……狄奇向馬炭談起當日放走沅婉的原因，重申只視她為親人。招兵海報引起偶像效應，卻無人報名。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子看見花輪的教科書劃了螢光筆很漂亮，便問他借來一用，好讓自己有動力溫習。小丸子發現永澤種了絲瓜田，細問之下得知對方要製作絲瓜擦，小丸子於是跟他學造絲瓜擦，以送給爺爺作生日禮物。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 又來到「粵劇READY GO」遊戲，這回的小朋友分成男、女子隊比拼。面對有關頭飾、「掌板」、上馬動作的問題，雖然兩隊均答錯未能得分，曉瑩老師卻送上暖心鼓勵，提醒大家勝負並非重點，最緊要是從錯誤中吸收正確的粵劇知識！玲玲姐姐於「Artspiration」示範畫薄餅，螢幕前的小朋友跟着畫時亦可加入喜歡的餡料。用廁紙筒作上色道具，意外造出漸變效果。其間，玲玲姐姐還溫馨細訴童年薄餅生日派對的難忘點滴。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄使用「隨心所欲手袋」取回失物，卻得意忘形以之表演魔術，手袋被胖虎搶走後引發混亂。多啦A夢為流浪貓多啦次郎尋找主人，最後靠「招財貓食品」讓拉麵店店主收養牠，更錯有錯著令店舖生意大增。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作粵
programme.desc: 啟德跑道區新盤相繼落成，提供不少海景大單位，其中一個四房外望維港，有否升值空間？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 有理說得清粵
航向未來粵
programme.desc: 運輸及物流局積極推動本港的海空聯運，節目《航向未來》由星級藝員吳偉豪、郭柏妍擔綱演出，並飾演初到海運前線的實習生，透過實況情節，介紹當局如何精準高效地協調貨船泊進港口後，把船上貨物經香港轉運出海，繼而運往世界各地，同時為國際航運業綠色減碳出力。

programme.title: 富途證券特約:富途講美股粵 及 東張西望粵
黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#74粵
programme.desc: 龔喜生活習慣「滋整」，嘉冰等人諸多不便，嘉驄終於忍無可忍斥責她，更指她只是外人。龔喜深感委屈，躲在房內不肯見人，朱基替她抱不平，更列舉事例指摘眾人漠視衛生。嘉驄等人才得知龔喜有嚴重潔癖，遂向她道歉，雙方言歸於好。龔喜自此再無顧忌，變本加厲滅菌，眾人苦不堪言，遂設法勸她與細菌共存，卻適得其反。其後，嘉冰獲安多勳啟發，想到幫助龔喜克服細菌恐懼的方法；豈料龔喜識破計劃，更突生變故，嘉冰身陷險境……

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#10粵PG 及 才駿HASHTAG 信證窩輪牛熊新勢力粵
programme.desc: 《死亡揭露》錄影當日，鳳儀否認與安安的意外有關……德龍看了子盈的日記，恍然眾女對子盈所做的惡行。雲生要將鳳儀「流放」外地，下屬徐曄為鳳儀求情不果。雲生資金告急，被卡冕國易先生施壓。無雙與德龍追查發現安安曾以內幕勒索某人，德龍察覺那人可能是菲雅，遂藉接近菲雅以確認。德龍發現寶兒擁有他當年送贈子盈的項鍊，隱然意會寶兒和子盈的關係。透過天誠招商會的場合，無雙認定綺雲、鳳儀、菲雅都有殺害子盈的嫌疑……

programme.title: 豐隆旅遊保險呈獻：跟風旅行團粵 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特約：健康一分鐘粵
programme.desc: 三清洞是結合傳統、藝術、美食的文青熱點，如風「跟風」開展一日遊。首站來到地膽推介的家庭式餐廳，品嚐熱上的「真正泡菜」、白切五花肉，勁滿足！為了製作手工鎖匙扣行上半山，卻得知項目下架，如風唯有轉造行李牌，又頻頻要導師出手代勞……山腳聚集不少潮流店舖，如風沿路找到韓屋雪糕店，試試甜薯焦糖布甸配軟雪糕等限定口味。轉往特色咖啡廳，望着地標城牆歎甜品，別具格調。乘巴士遊覽市內風光，醉人日落、夜景一次過收藏！

programme.title: 武則天#31粵普
programme.desc: 媚娘勸李治競逐太子以保兄長，世民亦查出李泰操控太子之亂。蕭薔服五行草滑胎，將罪名嫁禍韋妃及媚娘。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作粵
騙中傳奇#16粵
programme.desc: 黑衣人之主子原來是當今皇上嘉慶，他活捉了忠正，要忠正替他辨事，忠正記掛「天下無雙酒」一事，遂求嘉慶幫承康解圍。事後承康決定結束酒莊，歸隱田園。嘉慶要忠正出售宮中寶物，但不可洩漏其來源。一富豪將所有寶物叫價高至三十倍，更全數買下，嘉慶雖對此富豪來歷心感疑惑，但仍重賞忠正等人。一班衙差捉去玉麟等人，忠正立即找嘉慶幫忙。嘉慶早料到是權臣和珅所為，立即率眾救人。和珅府內，玉麟等正被要脅供出幕後賣家。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 日前尖沙咀寶勒巷發生奪命車禍，一輛私家車失控衝上行人路，釀成1死3傷慘劇。目擊者直指涉事司機疑似醉駕，現場市民亦親述驚險經過。中六女生「報東張」，哭訴遭六名昔日曾視為好友的同學集體霸凌，不但受盡言語辱罵與滋擾，更被惡意「起底」公開其個人資料。事主稱因此承受巨大壓力，情緒崩潰。面對連串指控，其中兩名涉事女生現身反駁，攝製隊安排雙方對質……陳豪、陳慧琳現身馬場，為活動擔任嘉賓。另送上實用長者生活情報。

programme.desc: 出發前，蘇夢枕將紅袖刀交給要假扮成他的小石，並教他一個招式，說江湖中人看到就會相信；蘇遮幕將扳指交給蘇夢枕，叮囑他要守好這個江湖，並要他去問花無錯是否知錯，父子倆一起喝下最後一杯酒，夢枕登上樓主之位。

programme.desc: 朋向溢道出身患心臟病，悅卻說出婷扭傷的消息。朋擔心悅接受不了雙重打擊，打消向太太坦白念頭。另一方面，慶與喜的磨擦進一步白熱化，慶更提出要到寺院修行，義更因此在父母面前大發脾氣，眾人大驚唯有再找朋解決。

programme.title: 說英雄誰是英雄#4粵普PG
programme.desc: 王小石和白愁飛被刑部尚書傅宗書關進牢中，蘇夢枕出面救了二人，惟尚書不准二人進入金風細雨樓；二人拒絕加入六分半堂，在京城過著落魄的日子，當二人打算離京之際，被溫柔攔下，並在其引見下與蘇夢枕結拜為兄弟。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
阿媽教落食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽購買何首烏、黑豆、豬尾做出多道補腎、護髮菜式。「護髮首烏湯」內有甚麼藥材？黑豆雖然有益，但煮「黑豆蓮藕燜豬尾」時切忌下太多，為甚麼？將海帶汆水及「過冷河」後，肥媽用檸檬汁、豆瓣醬、魚露等混出完美的涼拌醬。肥媽展示創意及「嶄新」刀功，為蒸鱸魚做出「孔雀開屏」的效果。何首烏與芝麻攪碎，另加馬蹄粉、粘米粉用水開稀，蒸約半小時，便有一份護髮兼討人歡喜的小甜點端上餐桌！

programme.title: 才駿HASHTAG 信證窩輪牛熊新勢力粵
programme.desc: 《才駿HASHTAG》匯聚各界精英，每周與您分享名家視角、更新市場焦點熱話。

programme.title: 航向未來粵
programme.desc: 運輸及物流局積極推動本港的海空聯運，節目《航向未來》由星級藝員吳偉豪、郭柏妍擔綱演出，並飾演初到海運前線的實習生，透過實況情節，介紹當局如何精準高效地協調貨船泊進港口後，把船上貨物經香港轉運出海，繼而運往世界各地，同時為國際航運業綠色減碳出力。

programme.title: 流行都市粵 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特約：健康一分鐘粵
programme.desc: 詹天文、廖嘉敏一同作客節目，暢談各自參演青春音樂劇續篇的點滴。天文透露將唱演獨腳戲，還會邀請現場觀眾上台互動；嘉敏又會挑戰甚麼角色？嘉敏本職是心理學家，提到工餘時演戲成為她抒發情緒的方式。這次「跟大廚去搵食」，大王、秀怡隨許美德師傅走進逾九十年歷史的老字號茶室，透過雞蓉鷓鴣粥、燒雲腿鵪鶉球、脆皮糯米雞、玉簪炒田雞腿等懷舊手工菜，細味昔日香港飲食文化。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐示範「臭豆蕎頭粉絲蝦煲」。

programme.title: 拍檔廚房粵
programme.desc: 第二、第三個回合由藝員、廚師分開各自比拼。黎諾懿被指「以本傷人」，「五分鐘速煮」用上生蠔、煙燻的元素，更輕鬆等到夠鐘！另邊廂，龔嘉欣將喜歡的豉椒炒花甲變奏成快速版「松露花甲茶碗蒸」。翠如投訴擺盤方面有不公平對賽，所為何事？「廚師主理」，李家鋌選用南瓜做主角，讓評判滿臉問號，以素食來比賽可會吃虧？對方沈依紅則依上海菜「洋蔥鴨」改良為兩吃，當中的雲吞包裹了鴨肝、鴨肉，別開生面。這回合，卻有人拿到滿分？

programme.title: 才駿HASHTAG 信證窩輪牛熊新勢力粵
programme.desc: 《才駿HASHTAG》匯聚各界精英，每周與您分享名家視角、更新市場焦點熱話。

programme.title: 大帥哥#9粵
programme.desc: 羅義及馬炭的總教官爭奪戰，引來大批鎮民觀看，落蘆趁機開賭盤，反應熱烈。最後一回合，狄奇甚至將頭顱也押下去，藉賭盤籌措更多軍費，不過最終還是沒人報名當兵。狄奇向落蘆借了一條金條，表示有辦法成功徵兵……軍事訓練學校成功開辦，但因軍人質素低劣，狄奇四兄弟採用極端的訓練方式，惹沅婉不滿，甚至要求入軍校做軍醫。艾妞、天嬌爭相討好狄奇，爭奪大帥府的話事權，卻發覺沅婉贏盡一切，決定暫時休戰，聯手對付沅婉。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子想吃番薯蛋糕，但媽媽不肯買，她於是想到用舉行讀書會作借口，讓媽媽買蛋糕回來招待朋友。小丸子化身童話故事《不萊梅樂隊》的驢子，與花貓、狗和公雞結伴前往不萊梅溫泉樂園組樂隊謀生。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 參與「廠長話」遊戲時，太「聽話」或是一大弱點。某小兵於熱身賽照單全收，每個動作指令都跟着做……進入淘汰賽，兩隊戰況非常激烈，哪一方可以留到最後？採摘水果的任務，曲奇隊於果園不慎「失手」了兩次，薯片隊則與障礙物完全「零接觸」，只是腳步聲有點大！最後一關是要走過「溶化之橋」，大家都勇於挑戰運送六個雪糕球！有人失手後再接再厲，卻見頂層雪糕球不停搖動，只得暫時停步，待穩定下來後才繼續前行……

programme.title: 藍色管弦樂粵日
programme.desc: 青野在武田老師鼓勵下，決定重拾小提琴並報考海幕高中。秋音一邊教他溫習，一邊接受他的指導練琴，二人互相扶持，終於一同考上。入學禮上，他們被海幕高中管弦樂團的震撼演奏深深吸引，新的音樂旅程亦正式展開。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 患有阻塞性睡眠窒息症的患者，因睡眠中氣道塌陷和缺氧，導致大腦在被「嗆醒」的瞬間，會下意識「咬緊牙關」，通過往前頂下巴希望打通呼吸，因此會出現磨牙。據臨床統計，患有阻塞性睡眠窒息症的患者，磨牙比率高於一般人，大約每4人就有1人，患者白天出現嗜睡、晨起頭痛等併發症。除了第一線治療使用正壓呼吸器，牙科醫生可透過矯治器幫助紓緩症狀。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 富途證券特約:富途講美股粵 及 東張西望粵
黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#75粵
programme.desc: 嘉冰、唐芯與龔喜目睹楚瑠香遭渣男騙財後拋棄，瑠香苦苦糾纏，更險遭動粗，龔喜遂出手制止，唐芯更揚言要替她物色好男人。瑠香懇求三人協助擺設相士所授的桃花陣以催旺姻緣，嘉冰本不以為然，卻難敵瑠香百般哀求而心軟。原來瑠香為擺桃花陣大費周章，終誘使嘉冰等三人配合她以古怪造型完成儀式，豈料眾人後來卻揭發一切只是相士的欺詐技倆。嘉冰等人助瑠香追討賠償，並替她改造成女神形象，透過交友App成功約會高質素男士……

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#11粵PG
programme.desc: 菲雅、綺雲、鳳儀被加入神秘群組，三人都猜測是無雙所為卻彼此猜忌。《玫瑰》劇組重組，無雙希望由鳳儀頂替安安，鳳儀為留在雲生身邊，縱覺有詐仍答允。無雙又提出將劇本改成緝兇方向，此時菲雅卻表示要辭演。德龍因寶兒持有「海龍之心」項鍊，懷疑寶兒身分，欲進一步查探時，無雙直接告知他答案……雲生向家俊提出合作串流平台，家俊欲威脅永康支持……雲生面對易先生施壓，鳳儀的一着成功為雲生化解危機。

programme.title: 豐隆旅遊保險呈獻：跟風旅行團粵 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特約：健康一分鐘粵
programme.desc: 安國站可謂富「歷史味道」區域，但只要識玩，也有時尚感。先到排隊食店喝一碗濃濃的人蔘雞湯，雞肉、湯分開上，如風略嫌蔘味不及雞味濃。百多年歷史的韓屋改造成住宿，傳統之餘亦有現代的智能馬桶，如風睡上床就不想離開？另一間法式外表建築，賣的是低調奢華手袋，愛高調的如風又能否買到心頭好？韓國人的咖啡吞吐量不少，如風私心推介既可打卡又好味的民村風咖啡店，代價是花時間覓路。還會走進超人氣商店，搜羅即沖咖啡做手信。

programme.title: 武則天#32粵普
programme.desc: 蕭薔滑胎案與刺殺媚娘案令韋妃罪證確鑿；李泰助韋妃自盡以保自身。韋家倒台，媚娘繼續追查太子案及文娘死因。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
騙中傳奇#17粵
programme.desc: 和珅暗諷嘉慶出賣國寶，嘉慶唯有委託他建造戰船，著他放玉麟等人，但和珅堅持暫將玉麟等人收監。忠正斥嘉慶怕事，獨自往救玉麟卻被和珅衙差追殺，時寶兒出現，忠正騎上寶兒快馬離去。寶兒巳是和珅之寵妾，得悉玉麟被困和珅府，即掉下忠正離去。忠正與嘉慶帶同「天下第一牙」牌匾，要和珅看在先帝份上釋放玉麟等人，其間和珅及嘉慶均無意中發現「風調雨順」四個神像之內裡乾珅。嘉慶委託忠正找出此四神像，忠正施計擺脫和珅之線眼。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 美女廚房粵
programme.desc: 曹永廉、黃浩然再任嘉賓，今次找來黎耀祥一同試食，今集再玩雙人賽制，當中兩對美女煮得有板有眼，滿分美食陸續送上！比較失色的一對，可能與有人「串嘴但有禮貌」有關，主持狠踩她的廚藝，讓她突然淚眼盈眶，主持怎樣打圓場？指定食材麵包蟹有一定份量，黎耀祥竟然只找到兩條蟹肉絲？振朗多番要求餵食，視帝黎耀祥亦有「另類」待遇！四位公公聚首，踩人、自嘲自然無極限，不過亦有強差人意菜式令眾男一致掃清，背後有何特殊原因？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

programme.desc: 朋與溢將事實告知眾人，悅表現出堅強的一面，支撐起大局。晚上朋卻發現悅只是在強裝鎮定，眾人開解將失業的溢，溢卻表示借此闖一番事業。朋終於接受手術，眾人紛紛到醫院陪伴，慶更在病床前告訴朋一個秘密。

programme.title: 說英雄誰是英雄#5粵普PG
programme.desc: 龍嘯青不悅白愁飛當上副樓主，狄飛驚從中挑撥；龍嘯青設局想拿下狄飛驚，卻被李念堂背叛，反被狄飛驚抓回六分半堂；小石來到關龍嘯青的牢獄，不料遇上朱小腰，救出龍嘯青後，朱小腰表明自己是金風細雨樓的弓箭手…

阿媽教落食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽一連兩集煮出十道與蝦相關的菜式。兩母子走到「蝦之百貨」，選購生猛基圍蝦、海中蝦及赤米蝦入饌。蝦仁拍成蝦膠，加雪耳、蛋白後搓成丸子，再放上杞子，蒸出滿有詩意的「白雪明珠」。買蝦通常越大越好，為何「龍井蝦仁」的蝦仁卻越小越好？肥媽教路，輕易煮出「花雕醉蝦」、「黃金蝦」兩道大熱菜式，黃金蝦加了甚麼令食者減輕因蛋黃而生的罪疚感？將赤米蝦混入牛油果、番茄之中，「牛油果甜蝦莎莎」就此誕生。

programme.title: 航向未來粵
programme.desc: 運輸及物流局積極推動本港的海空聯運，節目《航向未來》由星級藝員吳偉豪、郭柏妍擔綱演出，並飾演初到海運前線的實習生，透過實況情節，介紹當局如何精準高效地協調貨船泊進港口後，把船上貨物經香港轉運出海，繼而運往世界各地，同時為國際航運業綠色減碳出力。

programme.title: 流行都市粵 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特約：健康一分鐘粵
programme.desc: 多數更年期女士均會經歷潮熱，如嚴重還會影響日常生活，持續潮熱亦可增加患上心血管疾病的風險。治療方面，現時採用的非荷爾蒙藥物如何做到改善這症狀？留意婦產科醫生詳細解說。膽管炎有很多種類，成因、治療方法都不同。外科醫生提到，在香港最常見的病因是由膽石引起，膽石又是怎樣形成？醫生提醒患者不應因膽石體積小而忽略，而均衡飲食與適當運動均有助預防膽石及膽管炎。「睇餸食飯」，譚詠儀師傅示範「港味花螺」。

programme.title: 拍檔廚房粵
programme.desc: 第四回合，拍檔們要透過頭盤、主菜、甜品去講一個故事。黎諾懿、沈依紅把冰室美食「法式化」，黎總style的羅宋湯、炒牛河與西多士，令人期待！龔嘉欣、李家鋌則思考將飲宴佳餚呈現。嘉欣細心洗刷主打食材鮑魚，並得評判提醒訣要；加入芭樂、乳酪的楊枝甘露，幻化少女粉紅色彩。未評分，兩隊先自行檢討，有人帶漏材料，有人感慨甜品狀態不如理想！雖有不足，眾評判的評語讚賞不停，最終哪對拍檔取勝，率先出線？

programme.title: 大帥哥#10粵PG
programme.desc: 艾妞、天嬌送涼茶為軍人打氣，士氣立即飆升！細龜、佘南談判合作對付狄奇，可惜談不攏，反被狄奇作弄及恐嚇二人不可瓜分祿豐鎮。有軍人意外偷窺沅婉，馬炭反應過於激烈，沅婉從狄奇口中知道馬炭失控背後經歷。沅婉稱可為馬炭的指套保用一輩子，馬炭情不自禁擁抱她。馬炭悄悄送上一瓶狗尾草，沅婉誤以為是狄奇所送，甜在心頭，馬炭臉色一沉，狄奇則似有所悟。軍人訓練未如理想，軍費卻所剩無幾，狄奇經落蘆提醒後要求鎮中富商交稅。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子想知道自己會說什麼夢話，於是聽從爺爺建議，嘗試用錄音機錄下自己的夢話。小丸子化身日本童話《漏雨老宅》中的小狼女，與一眾動物齊心協力調查濱治爺爺所說的最可怕事物是什麼東西。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 位於沙頭角的谷埔村是一條擁有逾三百年歷史的鄉村，至今仍保留着深厚的客家文化。而受獨特地理位置與殖民歷史影響，在村內溝通竟可能要用上英語、西班牙話等外語。「Kids’ Notes」嘉賓還介紹了客家飲食冷知識，例如現時的甜點糯米糍，就被指是源自傳統客家茶粿。谷埔村內保存了不少珍貴的歷史建築，大家如前往參觀，宛如穿越時空，重返昔日鄉村歲月。嘉賓還推介於村內的蘆葦田打卡，是欣賞日落的夢幻好去處。

programme.title: 藍色管弦樂粵日
programme.desc: 升上高中的青野仍逃避小提琴與人群，卻接連得知天才佐伯直入讀海幕。重遇大提琴手山田後，他隨秋音等人參觀管弦樂團，竟被安排與佐伯即場合奏《四季．春》，久違的競爭心與過去亦再度被喚醒。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作粵
programme.desc: 長沙灣一個樓盤，有新一期單位交樓，房門設計狹窄，露台外牆有瓷磚已剝落，為何如此？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵 及 航向未來粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#76粵
programme.desc: 嘉驄被迫創作黑化圓妃的漫畫故事，陳公子更派編輯貼身催稿。嘉驄提出折衷方案，欲加入新角色替代圓妃「做壞事」，陳公子拒不接受更以巨額賠償逼嘉驄就範。編輯背着陳公子表示支持嘉聰的構思，獲嘉驄信任。唐芯到酒吧為嘉驄送銀包，編輯趁嘉驄離開向她遞上飲料，唐芯不虞有詐……翌日，圓圓及冠一發現嘉驄倒臥街頭，神智不清，送院後被驗出體內含有多種毒品。唐芯道出當晚發生的事，圓圓得知嘉驄慘況，決定親自替他解決問題……

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#12粵PG
programme.desc: 素希仗着自己懷孕登堂入室，永康事後向菲雅保證其在何家的地位。無雙得悉菲雅遭人以影片威脅，內容竟直接指向菲雅有殺害子盈的動機與嫌疑。家俊從另一途徑獲得影片，脅逼菲雅就範。綺雲在寧養院撞見女子Cindy，暗下憂心，因其握有重大秘密。寶兒積極為選秀節目《天選之人》排練，與另一練習生Jennie起衝突，不甘公司偏袒對方。寶兒向德龍透露，想與父親相認……菲雅在基金會投票上出爾反爾，家俊憤然要公開影片……

programme.title: 豐隆旅遊保險呈獻：跟風旅行團粵 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特約：健康一分鐘粵
programme.desc: 距離弘大區僅十五分鐘車程，就可發掘到瀑布靚景？坐在咖啡廳露台、漫步水畔步道，以不同角度拍出網美級相片。雨天更添寒意，如風藉新鮮龍蝦盛宴補暖。珍寶龍蝦拼盤啖啖肉，即食拉麵亦獲龍蝦加持，如風大讚似皇帝般享受！踏足汝矣島公園，如風再次挑戰高空，登上熱氣球竟附送「過山車」體驗？漢江美景當前，如風不再是畏高的我！西班牙菜Omakase六百港元有找？如風一嚐「白湯匙」大廚融合分子料理的手藝，連碟底都要舐乾淨！

programme.title: 武則天#33粵普
programme.desc: 媚娘訓練李治論政，助他在朝堂一鳴驚人；世民則懷疑李牧假身分。徐慧告發李牧與媚娘舊情，李治亦與李牧正面衝突。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之玩轉澳門新搞作粵
騙中傳奇#18粵
programme.desc: 忠正找到四神像，和珅手下亦至，眾情急下帶走最輕的「順」神像，和珅手下取走其餘三神像。神像地下印有滿文，忠正將文字製成拓布，並將「順」神像收藏好即回京。嘉慶見拓文，娓娓道出當年雍正之手諭，指大清有一禍胎潛伏，真相在「順」神像內；和珅亦已同步知悉秘密。忠正與玉麟出發找尋「順」神像秘密，顧井竟遇上寶兒，寶兒套取忠正行蹤。玉麟終從「順」神像得到最後一篇滿文，秘密是乾隆竟是漢人，嘉慶要忠正等立即消滅神像。

programme.title: Sunday好戲王粵PG
programme.desc: 龔嘉欣、何君誠、張美妮、喬寶寶互拼演技，釋放搞笑力量！四人中有一位另有「短跑好手」的身分，他們分別於「我係大話精」遊戲「示範」熱身、起跑及壓線動作，形態真假難分，「星級」評判陳松伶能否猜出誰是「飛毛腿」？今回「扮Friend食老虎」的「Friend底」名人，與松松有個共通點，到底一眾嘉賓可否令「扮Friend者」現形？深入民心的「騙子王」演員現身「另類好戲王」，分享出神入化的幕前「呃人」伎倆。

programme.title: SOS！小仙女曼曼
programme.desc: 在魔法王國，不論是穿不下玻璃鞋、被三隻小豬欺負，還是遇到壞女巫，只要大喊「SOS！小仙女曼曼」，小仙女曼曼就會用雨傘魔杖為你解決問題！

programme.title: 夫婦的世界
programme.desc: 【閨蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宮血洗渣男小三】醫院副院長池善雨擁有令人羨慕的完美生活，卻因一根神祕髮絲，驚覺導演丈夫早已出軌富家千金，且身邊摯友全都是幫忙隱瞞的幫兇。面對愛情與友情的雙重背叛，徹底心碎的她不再隱忍，決心化身復仇女神。她智商在線地精心設局，利用財產、孩子與社會地位作為籌碼，與丈夫展開一場玉石俱焚的心理戰與利益爭奪，將虛偽的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 夫婦的世界
programme.desc: 【閨蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宮血洗渣男小三】醫院副院長池善雨擁有令人羨慕的完美生活，卻因一根神祕髮絲，驚覺導演丈夫早已出軌富家千金，且身邊摯友全都是幫忙隱瞞的幫兇。面對愛情與友情的雙重背叛，徹底心碎的她不再隱忍，決心化身復仇女神。她智商在線地精心設局，利用財產、孩子與社會地位作為籌碼，與丈夫展開一場玉石俱焚的心理戰與利益爭奪，將虛偽的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 南風知我意
programme.desc: 【《蓮花樓》成毅在搭張予曦，再現《與君歌》絕美默契！！】藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯繫。一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 夫婦的世界
programme.desc: 【閨蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宮血洗渣男小三】醫院副院長池善雨擁有令人羨慕的完美生活，卻因一根神祕髮絲，驚覺導演丈夫早已出軌富家千金，且身邊摯友全都是幫忙隱瞞的幫兇。面對愛情與友情的雙重背叛，徹底心碎的她不再隱忍，決心化身復仇女神。她智商在線地精心設局，利用財產、孩子與社會地位作為籌碼，與丈夫展開一場玉石俱焚的心理戰與利益爭奪，將虛偽的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 漢摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅羅×金明洙×成東鎰，三人三色法官個性，尋找法庭正義！！】三位個性截然不同的法官，在現實與理想間的掙扎與選擇。熱血直率的新任法官及冷靜理性的資深法官同事。每一場審判，都是對人性與制度的考驗。在案件背後，他們不只判案，更在學習如何面對自己心中的「正義」。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 雙軌
programme.desc: 【何與×虞書欣偽骨科繼兄妹禁忌愛戀，從愛妹到曖昧火花四射！！】姜暮9歲前是被家人寵在手心的小女孩，靳朝是天之驕子的哥哥。那年父母離婚，兩人命運自此走上雙軌，爸爸和哥哥移居泰國，成為地下賽車與拳場中的修車工。多年後，19歲的姜暮得知哥哥是被領養的秘密，瞞著所有人獨自飛往泰國。在泰國的租屋中兩人展開了一段隱秘而甜蜜的情感旅程，在光明與黑暗間重逢，禁忌拉扯中雙向救贖。

programme.title: 夫婦的世界
programme.desc: 【閨蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宮血洗渣男小三】醫院副院長池善雨擁有令人羨慕的完美生活，卻因一根神祕髮絲，驚覺導演丈夫早已出軌富家千金，且身邊摯友全都是幫忙隱瞞的幫兇。面對愛情與友情的雙重背叛，徹底心碎的她不再隱忍，決心化身復仇女神。她智商在線地精心設局，利用財產、孩子與社會地位作為籌碼，與丈夫展開一場玉石俱焚的心理戰與利益爭奪，將虛偽的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 夫婦的世界
programme.desc: 【閨蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宮血洗渣男小三】醫院副院長池善雨擁有令人羨慕的完美生活，卻因一根神祕髮絲，驚覺導演丈夫早已出軌富家千金，且身邊摯友全都是幫忙隱瞞的幫兇。面對愛情與友情的雙重背叛，徹底心碎的她不再隱忍，決心化身復仇女神。她智商在線地精心設局，利用財產、孩子與社會地位作為籌碼，與丈夫展開一場玉石俱焚的心理戰與利益爭奪，將虛偽的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 南風知我意
programme.desc: 【《蓮花樓》成毅在搭張予曦，再現《與君歌》絕美默契！！】藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯繫。一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 夫婦的世界
programme.desc: 【閨蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宮血洗渣男小三】醫院副院長池善雨擁有令人羨慕的完美生活，卻因一根神祕髮絲，驚覺導演丈夫早已出軌富家千金，且身邊摯友全都是幫忙隱瞞的幫兇。面對愛情與友情的雙重背叛，徹底心碎的她不再隱忍，決心化身復仇女神。她智商在線地精心設局，利用財產、孩子與社會地位作為籌碼，與丈夫展開一場玉石俱焚的心理戰與利益爭奪，將虛偽的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 南風知我意
programme.desc: 【《蓮花樓》成毅在搭張予曦，再現《與君歌》絕美默契！！】藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯繫。一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 漢摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅羅×金明洙×成東鎰，三人三色法官個性，尋找法庭正義！！】三位個性截然不同的法官，在現實與理想間的掙扎與選擇。熱血直率的新任法官及冷靜理性的資深法官同事。每一場審判，都是對人性與制度的考驗。在案件背後，他們不只判案，更在學習如何面對自己心中的「正義」。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 雙軌
programme.desc: 【何與×虞書欣偽骨科繼兄妹禁忌愛戀，從愛妹到曖昧火花四射！！】姜暮9歲前是被家人寵在手心的小女孩，靳朝是天之驕子的哥哥。那年父母離婚，兩人命運自此走上雙軌，爸爸和哥哥移居泰國，成為地下賽車與拳場中的修車工。多年後，19歲的姜暮得知哥哥是被領養的秘密，瞞著所有人獨自飛往泰國。在泰國的租屋中兩人展開了一段隱秘而甜蜜的情感旅程，在光明與黑暗間重逢，禁忌拉扯中雙向救贖。

programme.title: Paris La Blanche
programme.desc: In this parable of migration, Rekia, 70 years-old, leaves Kabylie for Paris to fetch her husband, Nour, back home. Nour has been sustaining the family from abroad for 40 years. Finding help in new friends, she finds Nour but he is a changed man.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: When photographer Marlene's son Jason faces a life-altering skateboarding accident, their journey to healing takes unexpected turns. As they travel from Berlin to Switzerland, Jason slowly convinces his mother that life takes detours.

programme.title: Codename Holec
programme.desc: Honza films the Russian invasion of 1968 in Prague and takes the politically charged movie and actress Eva, the love of his life, on a secret trip to Vienna. There they meet a director who knows Eva very well and the Czech Secret Service even better.

programme.title: Midnight At The Paradise
programme.desc: Over the course of one evening, three couples are pulled into a collision course of sexual chemistry, delusion, forgiveness and hope as they explore what love, death, desire and the magic of the movies mean to them.

programme.title: éAv
programme.desc: While hitchhiking from Sofia to Ruse, Kamen meets Avé, a 17-year-old runaway girl. A compulsive liar, Avé keeps inventing new identities and backstories, which threaten to get Kamen deeper and deeper into trouble.

programme.title: To My Beloved
programme.desc: Fernando is a good man who takes care of his only child, Daniel. Following the death of his wife Ana, every night Fernando recalls their love as he sorts out his beloved dead spouse’s belongings. One day he finds a VHS tape that will change everything.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Nomads
programme.desc: As new environmental regulations crack down on burning ancestral offerings during the Qing Ming Festival, Wang and Ming must find a way to send a ceremonial paper boat to Ming’s parents in the afterlife.

programme.title: Murder in Mont St. Michel
programme.desc: A seemingly mystical murder takes Captain Sophie back to Mont-Saint-Michel, her childhood home and where her father is buried. She meets an exorcist priest and is annoyed by his silence but she's far from suspecting that a weighty secret unites them.

programme.title: A Dose Of Happiness
programme.desc: Vesala’s search for happiness led her into an early marriage and a 3-year-old daughter. After her marriage fails, she and her daughter are brought down a path that leads to hell and back, one which brings her through drugs, fall, fear and redemption.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Hatzegopteryx Display
programme.desc: When Jen's drone goes missing on Dino Island, Andy heads out to track it down. He discovers one of the island's inhabitants, a giraffe-sized pterosaur, called Hatzegopteryx, is using the drone for a very special purpose.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Rubber Duck
programme.desc: In the Fortress of Fun, Kingsley and Queenie play a game of Hide-and-Quack with the Playtimers to find their missing rubber ducks.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Voice Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels start talking to each other in the wrong voices it's clear something has gone awry. But Duggee has his voice badge. He knows what to do!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Stick Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are preparing to have a campfire. Duggee is getting it ready and needs the Squirrels to help find lots of wood for it. He needs small sticks, medium and big sticks... Lots of sticks!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Colour Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is painting in his favourite colouring book, and the Squirrels want to join in.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Mudslide
programme.desc: It's a very rainy day at the Go Jet Academy and the Go Jetters are teaching the Cadets some crucial Go Jetter skills. Meanwhile, Glitch has uprooted trees on the side of a large hill in order to build his rival Grim Dome Academy. But the lack of tree roots holding the soil together and the heavy rainfall leads to a mudslide! Glitch and his cadets need rescuing before they are washed away down the hill. Can the Go Jetters - with help from the Academy cadets - take on the power of the mudslide?

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - The Sphinx, Egypt
programme.desc: Glitch and the Grimbots are on holiday in Egypt where the Grimbots bury the Great Sphinx in sand, leaving only its head showing.

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends S24 - Sonny's Second Chance
programme.desc: Sonny returns to Sodor to try to be a really useful engine again but some of the other trains aren't willing to give him a second chance.

programme.title: Nikhil &amp; Jay S01 - Nikhil and Jay and the Deepavali Fireworks
programme.desc: Nikhil, Jay and their family celebrate Deepavali, also known as Diwali, with kolam, laddus and bunting. But will they be able to watch the fireworks without scaring Max the cat?

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Carnival
programme.desc: Stanley, Sophie and Benjamin make up a new game, 'Dino-Pirates'. This is such a good game, they use it as inspiration for Stanley's carnival float.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Bubbles
programme.desc: Stanley cleans Cynthia's bus, but each time he does it keeps getting dirty again. It's so dirty by the end, he invents a super-duper cleaning machine that makes a sea of bubbles.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - Not A Lemon... A Lem-ming!
programme.desc: Its not all cats and dogs when it comes to pets. Our talking animals have their own, very silly favourites.

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran S01 - It's time to look after Monty
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are looking after Monty the dog for the day. Whilst JoJo would like to see Monty's new rolling-over trick, she learns that there's much more to looking after a dog than just play.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Promises
programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Getting On Badge
programme.desc: When the squirrels upset the mole by being noisy, Duggee suggests ways that they can all live underground peacefully.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Dressing Up Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is wrapping a present because it is Enid's birthday. But the squirrels didn't get her anything! Maybe they could give her a surprise...but Enid doesn't like surprises. Norrie suggests dressing up, what a great idea!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Copy The King
programme.desc: The Squirrels play Copy the King!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Great Big Painting
programme.desc: One rainy day, Maisy and her friends make a giant painting!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Recycling Truck
programme.desc: Maisy and Tallulah drive their recycling truck around the community.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits S02 - Gooseberry
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, it's Gooseberry, singing a song about everything you have to do to become a Gooseberry Club member.

programme.title: Roots &amp; Fruits S02 - Festive Special

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Broccoli Flies Again
programme.desc: Evil Pea asks for flying lessons when Broccoli flies her paper plane into her freezer. Evil Pea doesn't let Broccoli know that she intends to fly high to take over Tato Tower.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Tin Can Games

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Say Hello

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Thirsty Robot

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Dino Dig

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. programme.desc: The Teletubbies go on a very special picnic together. Lots of Tubby Toast pops out of the Dup Dup and lands on the picnic plates for the Teletubbies to munch.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fan's fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancee, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - “Twelve Deadly Coins” and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan and disintegrating them from the inside. As more internal conflicts occur, will the masterminds of the clan find out who are the spys?

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father...

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father...

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master's identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed, Jia Yu sheds his playful ways and seeks vengeance, facing the Qing forces in a final battle.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Ying's father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt “Shaolin Hand Lock” from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling's house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: A young swordman, King Eagle, unwillingly gets involved in the internal affairs of a powerful clan and becomes their target. He is saved by the female chief of the clan, Lin, and falls in love with her. However, Lin's sister is part of all evil plots and betrays her. Even so, Lin begs King Eagle not to harm her sister.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own “Eight Diagram Pole Fight” and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Impoverished scholar Zhang Zhen seeks refuge with a chancellor's family, only to be scorned for his poverty. A carp spirit, moved by his plight, disguises herself as the chancellor's daughter and falls for him. Confusion over the two identical daughters draws a demon-hunting priest. Zhang Zhen refuses to abandon her, moving Guanyin to grant her mortal form.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy father's dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: IDC agent Jon survives a mission where his entire team is betrayed by their superior, Sean, leaving him with a life-threatening injury. Travelling to Malaysia to find his long-lost brother, he is drawn into a kidnapping case, only to discover his brother is involved, and Sean is the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes…

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to “Casino Tycoon”. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down…

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs II
programme.desc: In this prequel, the secrets of “Infernal Affairs” are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sam's wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Blinded on a counter-terrorism mission, former SWAT captain Dong Gu retires and lives with his daughter. When his old nemesis resurfaces and kidnaps her for an underground trafficking ring, Dong Gu must rely on his heightened hearing and formidable combat skills to hunt down the criminals and rescue his daughter.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: Scientist Yan Xin develops super rubber seeds and travels to a remote, lawless, drug-ridden region to cultivate them. Security captain Lin Xiang leads a team to protect his ex-wife and her crew, but they are besieged by a cartel on arrival. Lin Xiang and his men navigate hostile forces, vowing to take their enemies down with them.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...
